question: What PostgreSQL-specific features should Python backend developers know?
title: PostgreSQL Features for Python Developers
direct_answer: Key PostgreSQL features for Python devs: JSONB columns for semi-structured data with indexed access, array types, full-text search with tsvector/tsquery, window functions for analytics, CTEs (WITH clauses) for complex queries, RETURNING for insert/update/delete results, upsert with INSERT ON CONFLICT. PostgreSQL's EXPLAIN ANALYZE is essential for query optimization. pg_stat_statements tracks slow queries in production.
interviewer_intent: Tests PostgreSQL-specific knowledge beyond generic SQL — shows real production database experience.

sections.title: PostgreSQL-specific patterns in Python
sections.content:
from sqlalchemy import text, Column, Index
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB, ARRAY, TSVECTOR

# JSONB column
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'products'
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    metadata = Column(JSONB, default=dict)
    tags = Column(ARRAY(String), default=list)

# Index on JSONB field
Index('ix_product_metadata_type',
      Product.metadata['type'].astext,
      postgresql_using='btree')

# Query JSONB
result = await db.execute(
    select(Product).where(
        Product.metadata['type'].astext == 'electronics'
    )
)

# Full-text search
result = await db.execute(
    text("SELECT * FROM articles WHERE to_tsvector('english', body) @@ to_tsquery('english', :query)")
    .bindparams(query='python & fastapi')
)

# Upsert
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert
stmt = insert(User).values(email='test@example.com', name='Test')
stmt = stmt.on_conflict_do_update(
    index_elements=['email'],
    set_={'name': stmt.excluded.name, 'updated_at': func.now()}
)
await db.execute(stmt)

# RETURNING — get inserted ID without a round trip
stmt = insert(User).values(email='new@example.com').returning(User.id)
result = await db.execute(stmt)
new_id = result.scalar_one()

seo.metaTitle: PostgreSQL for Python — JSONB, Full-Text Search, Upsert, RETURNING
seo.metaDescription: PostgreSQL features every Python developer needs: JSONB columns, array types, full-text search, upsert with ON CONFLICT, and RETURNING clause.

speakable_v2.hook: PostgreSQL has features that make patterns simple that would require extra tables or application logic in other databases.

beats.content: JSONB stores and indexes JSON. Index specific JSONB fields with a functional index. Great for semi-structured data or configuration stored per-row.
INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE is the upsert — insert if not exists, update if exists. One query instead of select-then-insert-or-update.
RETURNING gets the inserted row's data (including server-generated ID) without an extra SELECT round trip.

speakable_v2.cap: pg_stat_statements is the first place to look for slow queries in production. It aggregates query statistics across all executions.
speakable_v2.followup_handoff: Follow up with GIN vs GiST index types for JSONB and full-text search, or advisory locks for distributed coordination.
